note: Where the Excel-archive series ids published before 11 October 2026 now point. The parser rebuild (PARSER_VERSION 2026.10.11) changed every EG.XL id: ids now carry the table, the heading path, the column (Exports / Imports, Public / Private), the base year and .A for fiscal-year figures. Each old id maps to the new series sharing the most (date, value) pairs with it, or to null where none shares at least 30% of its points: those old ids mixed several measures and no single successor is honest. From here on this file is maintained by hand: parse_excel.py refuses to drop a published id that is not listed here.
